purpose: First T05 research/staffing module, future equivalent complete report only.

scenario_definitions.meaning: Reusable method/design; readily available primary evidence and introduced participants; lower within-scope complexity.
Middle planning case; moderate evidence updating, coordination and editorial work.
Greater within-scope complexity, conflicting evidence, participant handling and revisions; not an upper limit.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Adapt an existing usable research structure, confirm reader/decision scope and plan the evidence work.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Reusing a framework does not make old findings current. No client approval or completed future edition assumed.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Focused new/update search, primary-source reading, extraction, contrary evidence and reference maintenance.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Includes useful evidence work, not repeating every internal check/file from the present project; paid datasets excluded unless separately selected.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Refresh the stable 14-question core/routing, forms, participant information and structured note/coding records for this edition.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Does not change the core or authorise data collection. New material method changes may need more effort.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Plan introduction handoff, calendar, reminders and status review using JGA-provided routes.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Not a recruitment guarantee. Variable individual handling is WR05; unsuccessful chasing beyond this assumed effort requires reforecast.

report_provider_tasks.task: Individual scheduling, permission administration and clearance routing
report_provider_tasks.basis: Allow individual arrangements, eligibility record handling, permission choices and necessary review routing.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Model completed usable contributors as a workload driver only; this is not a conversion-rate assumption. Extra unsuccessful attempts remain additional work if incurred.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Preparation, a short structured interview or equivalent written handling, prompt note completion and clarifying follow-up.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Not a promised interview duration. No recording/transcription or identifiable-data AI service assumed.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Code usable material, record missing/contrary input and prepare cross-case comparison.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Do not add a second full coding charge merely because the same permitted account informs Table analysis; extra Table-specific work stays separate.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Integrate desktop and original input, test contradictions, construct the supported Decision Framework and chapter logic.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Small purposive input is not representative benchmarking. This is synthesis effort, with prose drafting in WR09.

report_provider_tasks.task: Full narrative, executive summary and commercial preview
report_provider_tasks.basis: Draft the complete agreed report, concise summary and two-page preview using the working two-part/eight-chapter structure.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: No arbitrary report word/page ceiling; changed agreed length or evidence complexity requires reforecast. Research collection/synthesis are separate rows.

report_provider_tasks.task: Substantive fact, source, quotation and rights check
report_provider_tasks.basis: Check consequential statements, reference links, participant/publication limits, exact quotations and evidence-to-claim fit.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Not legal advice or a new ownership veto. WR05 administration and this publication review are distinct tasks; do not repeat the same clearance effort.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Improve language, consistency, tables and references; proof the final narrative/layout.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Editorial hours are a separate work package, not a second full research rewrite.

report_provider_tasks.task: JGA design and editable report assets
report_provider_tasks.basis: Design report PDF/Word, reusable original graphic assets and report chart-data files; incorporate summary and preview consistently.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Uses reusable design system and evidence-supported graphics. Excludes a website, Table financial workbook and invented quantitative charts.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Process one coordinated feedback set, revise within the agreed outline and propagate affected files.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Included contractual remedy work is not a new billable service. Allowance is planning effort, not a cap on corrections or an automatic surcharge.

report_provider_tasks.task: Final format/data QA and portable handover
report_provider_tasks.basis: Check exports, links, reusable chart data, editable assets, evidence/method templates and handover index.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Report supporting Excel data only; no duplicate charge for separate Table financial-model production.

report_provider_tasks.basis: Manage actual dependencies, client checkpoints, issue tracking and final handover coordination.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Own labour only. JGA-side decision/review time is retained resource cost, not the same person charged twice.

report_provider_tasks.task: First-edition research pricing and use-option preparation
report_provider_tasks.basis: Prepare evidence-supported report pricing/licensing options and appropriate commercial preview use.
report_provider_tasks.boundary: Count a common analysis once if it also informs Table feasibility. This row is not the full six-comparable Table assessment, sponsor sales or contract advice.

JGA_retained_tasks.basis: Provide operating context, decide focus and resolve questions.
JGA_retained_tasks.boundary: Proposed retained time, no named person or date assigned.

JGA_retained_tasks.basis: Identify suitable introductions, provide relevant role context and assist when contact stalls.
JGA_retained_tasks.boundary: Planning block, not an assumed conversion funnel or guaranteed number of recruitable contacts. More chasing can increase actual effort.

JGA_retained_tasks.basis: Review consequential payroll/employer interpretation and JGA supplied material.
JGA_retained_tasks.boundary: Retained expertise does not replace independent fact checking. Review time can overlap with other JGA tasks only if actual work is the same.

JGA_retained_tasks.basis: Coordinate Nick/Mark feedback and agreed within-scope decisions.
JGA_retained_tasks.boundary: Client time alongside provider WR13, not an extra provider invoice.

JGA_retained_tasks.basis: Confirm final publication/rights choices and practical receipt of assets.
JGA_retained_tasks.boundary: No approval, acceptance or publication permission presumed by the hours.

scope_guards: Current agreed ordinary research, analysis, writing, design and handover are included in the existing fixed fee; these hours do not authorise an extra charge.

For current JGA cash cost, use the applicable commission allocation once. Producer bottom-up hours are a future resource scenario/possible sourcing alternative, not an amount to add on top for the same contracted work.
For a future edition, select an actual supplier fee or bottom-up priced production tasks as the external-cost method, or clearly reconcile the actual subcontracted split; never blindly add both.
JGA retained time is additional full-resource effort and may be existing salary rather than extra cash. Rates/cash classification remain unchosen.
Contributor target is not the number of introductions, attempts, responses, permission clearances or selected citations. Distinct actual people count once.
The working eight-chapter structure and final length remain subject to the existing outline agreement; no fixed new word/page promise.
No participant incentive, tool purchase, paid dataset, bespoke legal review, translation or travel is included as a verified zero. These remain applicable-scope decisions.
Effort can exceed the high case. No timed pilot, supplier capacity, staffing or resource availability validates these assumptions.
confidence: Low as a prediction: no timed delivery, observed case throughput, staffing or future final length validates these analyst assumptions. Ranges are workload alternatives, not probability/confidence intervals.

dependency_definitions.DEP01: Agreed reader/focus, outline/length and available brand inputs
dependency_definitions.DEP02: Accessible current primary evidence and actual permission to reuse required third-party material
dependency_definitions.DEP03: Approved collection/data route, actual JGA introductions, consent and usable eligible contributions
dependency_definitions.DEP04: Coded actual input and supported synthesis; no assumed representative result
dependency_definitions.DEP05: Coordinated JGA feedback and publication decisions
dependency_definitions.DEP06: Actual appropriately skilled capacity and portable final-file checks
